episodes.title: Chapter One: Rare
episodes.summary: When a guest is murdered on a luxury ocean liner, Imogene Scott becomes the only suspect in an impossible crime. She didn't do it. So, who did?

episodes.title: Chapter Two: Sordid
episodes.summary: Rufus interrogates each of the major players on board. They're all hiding something… even Imogene's best friend.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: Troublesome
episodes.summary: Interpol seizes control of the investigation. Rufus and Imogene must now investigate the Colliers in secret.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Hidden
episodes.summary: As the manhunt for Jules intensifies, Imogene uncovers his criminal past… and finds a new witness.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Exquisite
episodes.summary: Who is Viktor Sams? Imogene and Sunil pursue a lead in Malta, while Rufus teams up with Leila and Teddy.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: Tragic
episodes.summary: Imogene is betrayed by someone close to her as more victims fall prey to Viktor Sams.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: Memorable
episodes.summary: Imogene walks in Rufus's shoes, revisiting the investigation into her mother's murder eighteen years ago.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: Vanishing
episodes.summary: Blackout. Three dead bodies. Everyone's terrified. The secrets unravel like Christmas presents. And Imogene confronts her mother's killer.

episodes.title: Chapter Nine: Impossible
episodes.summary: Viktor Sams takes control of the Varuna and forces the guests to bid against each other to survive. Will Imogene and her friends unmask him before time runs out?

episodes.title: Chapter Ten: Chilling
episodes.summary: Reeling from the truth, Imogene has a choice to make. Rufus writes a second memoir.
